prompts.front: Use case: photorealistic-natural / style-transfer. Create ONE portrait 4:5 photograph for a fictional Korean parenting influencer's impeccably clean family home. Input image 1 is the exact spatial and camera reference: a crude 3D mockup to convert into a convincing REAL CAMERA PHOTO. Preserve viewpoint, composition, room proportions, furniture positions and recognizable designs. Photograph an actual lived-in, carefully tidied high-end Korean apartment in gentle morning daylight. Natural subtle exposure variation and soft reflected window light; real oak grain with joints and tiny material imperfections; white matte painted surfaces, delicate fabric weave and soft seams, believable metal faucet and glass. Avoid CGI, illustration, showroom render, plastic smoothing, uniformly perfect geometry, crunchy artificial grain. Keep the WHITE rounded-rectangle dining tabletop on FOUR cylindrical OAK legs, TWO oak chairs with flat wooden backs and ivory seat pads, open picture book and white pencil cup, layered-disc WHITE pendant, white tall cabinet left and long white kitchen cabinets at rear, white island rear right, original LEFT window. Preserve their exact placement. The source frame has NO sofa, NO bookcase, NO coffee table, NO rug: do not add them. Keep bare pale oak floor. No people, no extra decor, no new windows, no added curtains, no words or watermark. Make photographic surface and light changes only; these proxies should become actual manufactured furniture, retaining the same design rather than their artificial render surfaces. Output only one photograph, no panels.
